newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes flat vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes flat vs dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka recovered early losses and closed flat at 43.7495/7500 to the dollar in interbank trading on Wednesday, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted weaker at 43.7500/7550 per dollar in early trade but recovered as the supply of the U.S. currency remained more or less comfortable for a second staright session.
The interbank call money rates closed softer at 4.5 to six percent in a liquid market against a previous six to seven percent, dealers said.
